reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Nettix (Alma Media) publishes an OpenAPI-documented Nettiauto REST API (ads CRUD, search, dealers) available to business customers on application.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Nettix API client id (Alma Media grants API access to business customers on application); used with grant_type=client_credentials at https://auth.nettix.fi/oauth2/token.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The client's secret. The 24-hour JWT it mints is sent as the X-Access-Token header.

adapter.terms: Nettix REST API (Alma Media) common guidelines: https://api.nettix.fi/docs/api-common.html. Prices in EUR, mileage in km.

search_listings.note: GET https://api.nettix.fi/rest/car/search (OpenAPI https://api.nettix.fi/docs/car/swagger.yaml): an array of ads for sale. make and model are Nettix option ids (integers from /options/make and /options/model, e.g. make=4), not names; query is free text (searchText); location/condition are not mapped (region/town take option ids). rows ≤ 100.

get_listing.note: GET https://api.nettix.fi/rest/car/ad/{id}: the full car ad (options as {id, fi, en}, images, equipment, seller info in raw).

not_offered.decode_vin: No VIN decoder in the Nettiauto REST API (vin is a search filter and ad field).
not_offered.get_valuation: The pricing-tool schemas are not exposed as a documented read operation for arbitrary vehicles.
not_offered.list_dealers: /my-dealers lists only the caller's own dealers, not a dealer directory.
not_offered.me: No identity endpoint for a client-credentials token.

evidence: host api.nettix.fi: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://api.nettix.fi/docs/car/swagger.yaml: 2/2 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
